package gofastmsbin

const (
	DefaultMaxInputBytes	= 1 << 30
	DefaultMaxDecodedBytes	= 2 << 30
	DefaultMaxCells	= 20_000_000
)
func Detect(r io.ReaderAt, size int64) string
func Extract(ctx context.Context, r io.ReaderAt, size int64, opts *gofastcore.Options) (*gofastcore.Document, error)
func ExtractFile(ctx context.Context, path string, opts *gofastcore.Options) (*gofastcore.Document, error)

type Extractor struct {
	MaxCells int64
}
func (e *Extractor) Extract(ctx context.Context, r io.ReaderAt, size int64, opts *gofastcore.Options) (*gofastcore.Document, error)
func (e *Extractor) ExtractFile(ctx context.Context, path string, opts *gofastcore.Options) (*gofastcore.Document, error)
func (e *Extractor) Formats() []string
func (e *Extractor) Open(path string, opts *gofastcore.Options) (*File, error)
func (e *Extractor) OpenBytes(data []byte, opts *gofastcore.Options) (*File, error)
func (e *Extractor) OpenReaderAt(r io.ReaderAt, size int64, opts *gofastcore.Options) (*File, error)

type File struct {
	// contains filtered or unexported fields
}
func Open(path string, opts *gofastcore.Options) (*File, error)
func OpenBytes(data []byte, opts *gofastcore.Options) (*File, error)
func OpenReaderAt(r io.ReaderAt, size int64, opts *gofastcore.Options) (*File, error)
func (f *File) Children(ctx context.Context) ([]*gofastcore.Document, error)
func (f *File) Close() error
func (f *File) Document(ctx context.Context) (*gofastcore.Document, error)
func (f *File) Format() string
func (f *File) Metadata() gofastcore.Metadata
func (f *File) NumParts() int
func (f *File) Part(ctx context.Context, number int) (gofastcore.Part, error)
func (f *File) Parts(ctx context.Context) iter.Seq2[gofastcore.Part, error]
func (f *File) Sheets() []Sheet
func (f *File) Source() gofastcore.Source
func (f *File) Warnings() []gofastcore.Warning

type Sheet struct {
	Number	int
	Name	string
	Hidden	bool
}
